title: Parent notifications (Telegram)
description: Messages to parents via the Telegram bot: “arrived / left / absent” and the excuse result. For now it works only in the selected pilot schools.

bot.title: Telegram bot
bot.envHint: Enter the token and address in the “Telegram bot connection” card on the System settings page.
bot.publicUrlHint: Enter the token and address in the “Telegram bot connection” card on the System settings page.

schools.title: Pilot schools
schools.description: Messages go only to parents of students in these schools. “Absent” is sent once after the shift start + waiting time (for classes without a shift — at the default time).
